note: RC2.9.4A — the Phase-A checkpoint (commit aa97104) frozen on its own gate. The three commits after aa97104 touch only rc2/ records (archived RC2.9.3 freeze, gate record, this freeze); the production bundle is the Phase-A tree unchanged. The freeze tool at this checkpoint labels the line RC2.9.3 and names holdout seed AUDIT-2026-09-13-L, the seed the RC2.9.3 freeze already spent: Phase A draws byte-identical questions to RC2.9.3 on the 10,000 reference seeds (rc2/RC294_ZERO_DIFF.json), so no new sign-off seed was assigned to this checkpoint. The RC2.9.4 release, which includes Phase B, is frozen separately against AUDIT-2026-09-13-M.
